newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still an ING sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cosipa still an ING sell.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it was maintaining its sell rating on Brazilian private steel firm Cosipa.
-- In a report, it said Cosipa faces significant stock overhang both in the common and preferred stocks.

-- It said profitability in the medium run is limited by high interest expenses, adding that, in the long term, profitability is expected to be limited by competition with steelmaker CST in the hot-rolled segment and with Usiminas and CSN in the cold-rolled segment.
-- ING Barings also said it expects Cosipa and Usiminas to merge eventually, leading to some synergy gains, especially at the administrative level.
-- Usiminas has 25 percent of Cosipa's total capital and 49 percent of the firm's voting capital.
-- Cosipa preferred rose 1.35 percent, closing at 0.75 reais.
